scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android && npm run cap:patch-android
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync && cap open android
scripts.apk:patch: node scripts/bump-version.cjs patch && npm run apk:debug
scripts.apk:minor: node scripts/bump-version.cjs minor && npm run apk:debug
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('../release_apk',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk', '../release_apk/draw-gyotong-v' + require('../package.json').version + '.apk')"
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.aab:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
